description: Defines logging event IDs, event names, and high-performance logging message methods for PDFsharp library, specifically for internal logging of PDF document creation, saving, page and graphics events, and PDF reading issues.

classes.name: PdfSharpEventId
classes.description: Contains constant integer IDs for various PDFsharp logging events, starting from a base ID.

classes.name: PdfSharpEventName
classes.description: Contains string names corresponding to PDFsharp logging events.

classes.name: PdfSharpEvent
classes.description: Defines EventId objects combining event IDs and names for logging purposes.

classes.name: LogMessages
classes.description: Contains static partial methods for high-performance logging messages related to PDFsharp events, using LoggerMessage attribute.

methods.name: PdfDocumentCreated
methods.description: Logs the creation of a new PDF document with its name.

methods.name: PdfDocumentSaved
methods.description: Logs that a PDF document has been saved.

methods.name: NewPdfPageCreated
methods.description: Logs the creation of a new PDF page.

methods.name: ExistingPdfPageAdded
methods.description: Logs that an existing PDF page was added.

methods.name: XGraphicsCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a new XGraphics object from a source.

methods.name: StreamIssue
methods.description: Logs an error related to stream issues during PDF reading.

methods.name: EndOfStreamReached
methods.description: Logs a warning when end of stream is reached prematurely.

methods.name: SkippedIllegalBlanksAfterStreamKeyword
methods.description: Logs a warning about skipping illegal blanks after a stream keyword.

methods.name: StreamKeywordFollowedBySingleCR
methods.description: Logs a warning about illegal CR following a stream keyword.

methods.name: StreamKeywordFollowedByIllegalBytes
methods.description: Logs a warning about illegal bytes following a stream keyword.
